features.title: Everything You Need to Perform
features.ai_desc: Personalized training plans built around your goals and weak points. Choose a focus — competition prep, high-volume conditioning, or balanced development — or let the app build a custom plan for you.
features.adaptive_desc: Your workouts shift to match how you feel. Fresh and rested? Push for a PR. Beat up? Lighter day, more skill work. Same plan, dialed up or down.
features.weekly_desc: Generate a coach-style write-up when you're ready: what went well, what didn't, and suggested focus for the week ahead.
features.meal_desc: Log meals, track macros against your targets, and upload a diet PDF from your nutritionist. Automatic meal plans by training day are on the roadmap.
features.recovery_desc: Log sleep and how you feel in under a minute on the web — four questions and your daily readiness is ready.
features.analytics_desc: Log PRs, session RPE, and volume trends as you train. Deeper monthly reports are coming; today you get the essentials in your dashboard.

loop.title: How It Works
loop.step1_desc: Answer four quick questions (sleep, energy, soreness, stress) in under 30 seconds.
loop.step2_desc: Based on how you feel, the app picks the right workout. Fresh? Push hard. Wiped? Lighter, smarter session.
loop.step3_desc: Run the workout. For strength, log set by set (weight, reps, ✓). For metcons, rate session RPE when you finish. Honest input drives better adjustments.
loop.step4_desc: When you generate your weekly review, you get a clear summary — strengths, weaknesses, and a suggested plan for next week (apply when you're ready).
loop.step5_desc: A few weeks of building volume, then a deload, then heavier intensity, then you test your PRs. Rinse and repeat.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers. Need more detail? See the help center.
faq.q1: What is CrossFit Health OS, in plain words?
faq.a1: A smart training partner that decides your workout each day based on how recovered you are. Train hard when you're fresh, ease off when you're not, and get a weekly check-in that adjusts the next week.
faq.q2: Do I need a wearable or special device?
faq.a2: No. Answer four quick questions each morning (sleep, energy, soreness, stress) in under 30 seconds — right in your browser — and the app does the rest.
faq.q3: How does the workout actually adapt to me?
faq.a3: Slept badly or feeling beat up? You'll get less volume and more skill or recovery work. Feeling great? You'll get the chance to push for a PR. Same plan, dialed up or down to match your day.
faq.a4: Choose a focus at signup: competition prep (high intensity), high-volume conditioning, or balanced development — or have the app build a custom plan around your goals and weak points.
faq.q5: I already have a nutrition plan. Can I skip the food stuff?
faq.a5: Yes. Choose Training Only at signup — we save that preference today. Hiding nutrition in the menu is rolling out soon; you can ignore the Nutrition tab until then.
faq.q6: Who can see my recovery and lab data?
faq.a6: Only you. Your data isn't sold or shared. We never reveal who you are to outside services.
faq.a7: Yes. 14-day free trial, no credit card needed. Cancel from the user menu → Billing. Self-serve data export after cancel is on the roadmap.
faq.a8: Yes. Full Portuguese, including the workouts and lab report reading. Switch language from your profile.

getting_started.title: Getting started
getting_started.p1: Sign up at /register. We'll ask a few questions about your goals (compete, get fitter, recover from injury), how long you've trained, what equipment you have, and how many days a week you can train. Takes about 3 minutes.
getting_started.p2: Pick Training Only if you've already got a meal plan you like, or Full Experience to get nutrition too. You can change this later from your profile.

recovery.title: Daily check-in
recovery.p1: Each morning, answer four quick questions: how long you slept, how rested you feel, how stressed you are, and how sore your muscles are. Twenty seconds, tops.
recovery.p2: Based on your answers, the app picks the right workout for the day. If you slept like a rock and feel sharp, expect a chance to push for a PR. If you're wiped, you'll get something lighter — skill work, mobility, or active recovery.
recovery.p3: Optional: add HRV and resting HR in the check-in if you have those numbers — they're not required.

today_workout.title: Today's workout
today_workout.p1: Open the app and see today's workout. Tap Start session to log — set by set for strength; overall session RPE when you finish metcons.
today_workout.p2: Don't like what you got? Tap Generate for a different option. The new one still respects your recovery — it just gives you a different flavour of stimulus.

programs.title: Training programs
programs.p1: A program is a multi-week plan with a clear arc — building volume, then peaking, then testing PRs. To create one, go to Programs → New Program, pick a style (competition, high volume, balanced, or custom), how many weeks, and how many sessions per week. The app builds the rest.
programs.p2: Hit Activate when you're happy with the plan and it fills your training calendar automatically. Only one program runs at a time; activating a new one replaces the old.
programs.p3: You can preview the whole thing — week by week, session by session — before activating. If something doesn't look right, just generate again.

schedule.title: Training calendar
schedule.p1: The Training Calendar shows your week at a glance. Tap any day to see what's planned, drag a session to a different day if life happens, or hit Start to begin.
schedule.p2: Want your workouts on your phone calendar too? Connect Google Calendar from Profile → Integrations and every session shows up automatically.

tracking.title: Logging sessions & PRs
tracking.p1: During strength work, log weight and reps set by set. For WODs, rate overall session RPE when you finish. Honest input drives better adjustments.
tracking.p2: Record PRs under Training → Add PR. Lifts and benchmarks stay in your history.

nutrition.title: Nutrition & meals
nutrition.p1: If you turn nutrition on, the app builds meal plans that match your training: more carbs on heavy days, more fats on rest days, and pre/post-workout meals timed around your sessions.
nutrition.p2: Already have a diet from a nutritionist? Upload the PDF and we'll bring it in. Don't want any food features? Stick with Training Only mode.

lab_reports.title: Blood test results
lab_reports.p1: Snap a photo of any blood panel — or upload the PDF — and the app reads the values for you. Things like testosterone, vitamin D, iron, blood sugar markers — each one tagged as low, normal, or high based on the lab's reference range.
lab_reports.p2: Works with reports in English and Portuguese. You'll see your results under the Health tab.

weekly_review.title: Weekly review
weekly_review.p1: Generate a review anytime under Reviews — a coach-style summary of your week: what went well, what didn't, recovery trends, and volume/intensity suggestions you can apply to next week.
weekly_review.p2: Past reviews live under Reviews so you can see progression over time. Apply adjustments when you're ready.

healthkit.title: Wearables (coming soon)
healthkit.p1: Today recovery comes from the morning check-in on the web. Apple Health and other wearables are on the roadmap.
healthkit.p2: No Apple device? No problem. The four-question check-in works just as well; the app doesn't need a wearable to know how you're doing.

language.title: Language & appearance
language.p1: Switch between English and Portuguese from Profile → Language. Your choice sticks across devices.
language.p2: Light or dark mode? The app follows your phone's setting by default — flip it manually from Profile → Appearance.

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.p1: No workout for today: head to Programs and activate a plan, or hit Generate on the dashboard for a one-off workout.
troubleshooting.p2: Calendar showing an error: usually means no active program. Pick one from Programs and refresh.
troubleshooting.p3: Lab report came out wrong: try a clearer photo or the original PDF. Blurry phone shots are hard to read — sharper input gives better results.
troubleshooting.p4: Anything else? Refresh the page first (sometimes that's all it takes). Still stuck? Email support — see below.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms govern use of CrossFit Health OS ("Service"), operated by [COMPANY NAME, CNPJ NN.NNN.NNN/0001-NN], headquartered at [ADDRESS]. By creating an account or using the Service, you ("User") agree to these Terms. If you don't agree, do not use the Service.

service.title: 1. What the Service does
service.p1: CrossFit Health OS is a digital platform supporting functional-fitness training. We generate personalized training plans from recovery data (sleep, heart rate, subjective ratings), track training loads, suggest nutrition, and read lab reports via artificial intelligence.
service.p2: The Service is a complementary organization and analysis tool. It does not replace in-person medical, physiotherapy, nutritional, or coaching care.

eligibility.title: 2. Who can use it
eligibility.p1: You must be at least 18 years old and have full legal capacity to use the Service. Minors may use it only with a legal guardian's supervision and explicit consent for data processing.
eligibility.p2: You confirm you are physically fit to perform high-intensity exercise. If you have a pre-existing medical condition, recent injury, or any doubt about your fitness, consult a professional before starting any workout suggested by the Service.

account.title: 3. Account and security
account.p1: You are responsible for keeping your password safe and for all activity on your account. Notify us at {support_email} immediately if you suspect unauthorized use.
account.p2: You agree to provide truthful, current information at signup. Accounts created with false data or someone else's identity may be terminated without prior notice.

subscription.title: 4. Subscription, trial and cancellation
subscription.p1: We offer a 14-day free trial, no credit card required. After that, access to premium features (AI-powered programs, adaptive workout generation, lab reading, weekly reviews) requires an active subscription.
subscription.p2: Billing is monthly at the price in effect at signup, in [USD/BRL]. You can cancel anytime under Billing. Access remains active until the end of the paid period — partial-month refunds are not provided.
subscription.p3: We may change prices with 30 days' email notice. Disputed charges must be communicated in writing within 90 days.

acceptable_use.title: 5. Acceptable use
acceptable_use.p1: You agree not to: (a) share your account; (b) reverse-engineer, copy, or redistribute Service-generated content; (c) use the Service to automate attacks, mass scraping, or abusive consumption of AI resources; (d) submit illegal, offensive, or rights-infringing content.

ip.title: 6. Intellectual property
ip.p1: The platform, code, brand, design, and aggregated content are owned by [COMPANY NAME] or its licensors. You receive a personal, non-transferable, revocable license to use the Service while your subscription is active.
ip.p2: Your input data (training logs, sleep metrics, lab reports, notes) remains yours. You grant us a limited license to process it and produce your personalized recommendations as described in our Privacy Policy.

health_disclaimer.title: 7. Health disclaimer
health_disclaimer.p1: CrossFit Health OS is not a medical service. Workouts, nutrition recommendations, lab readings, and any AI-generated analysis are informational and organizational only — they are not a diagnosis, prescription, treatment, or individualized medical, nutritional, physiotherapy, or coaching advice.
health_disclaimer.p2: Always consult a qualified professional before starting, modifying, or stopping any exercise, diet, or treatment program. If you experience pain, injury, cardiac symptoms, pregnancy, or any relevant medical condition, stop using the Service and seek professional care immediately.
health_disclaimer.p3: Automated lab reading is an information-organization feature — it may contain OCR or interpretation errors. Always verify values and reference ranges against the original report and a qualified medical professional.

third_party.title: 8. Third-party services
third_party.p1: To deliver the Service we integrate with third parties such as AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google), payment processor (Stripe), Apple Health, Google Calendar, and cloud infrastructure. These vendors have their own terms and policies, and some of your data may flow through them as described in the Privacy Policy.

liability.title: 9. Liability
liability.p1: The Service is provided "as is". We make reasonable efforts to keep it available and correct, but do not guarantee uninterrupted availability, error-free operation, or that AI recommendations are appropriate for any specific case.
liability.p2: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, our total liability to you is limited to the amount you paid for your subscription in the 12 months prior to the event. We are not liable for indirect damages, lost profits, or consequences of decisions made based on Service information.
liability.p3: Nothing in these Terms excludes liability that cannot be excluded under applicable law.

termination.title: 10. Termination
termination.p1: You may close your account at any time from Profile. After closure, we keep your data exportable for 30 days and then erase or anonymize it as described in the Privacy Policy.
termination.p2: We may suspend or terminate your account for breach of these Terms, fraud, non-payment, or court order, with notice when legally required.

changes.title: 11. Changes to these Terms

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Policy describes how CrossFit Health OS, operated by [COMPANY NAME, CNPJ NN.NNN.NNN/0001-NN] ("Controller"), processes your personal data under Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD, Law 13.709/2018) and, where applicable, the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

controller.title: 1. Who is the Controller
controller.p1: [COMPANY NAME], CNPJ [NN.NNN.NNN/0001-NN], headquartered at [ADDRESS]. Data Protection Officer (DPO): [NAME], {dpo_email}.

data_collected.title: 2. Data we collect
data_collected.p1: Account: name, email, password (stored as bcrypt hash), date of birth, weight, height, time zone, language.
data_collected.p2: Health and performance (sensitive category, LGPD art. 11): heart rate, heart rate variability (HRV), sleep duration and quality, stress level, muscle soreness, training records (loads, reps, RPE), personal records, lab biomarkers you choose to upload.
data_collected.p3: Payment: processed entirely by Stripe; we receive only subscription identifiers and status — we do not store card data.
data_collected.p4: Usage and technical: IP address, browser type, in-app actions, error logs, session identifiers.
data_collected.p5: Optional integrations: Apple Health (HRV, sleep, workouts), Google Calendar (access token to create events).

legal_basis.title: 3. Legal bases
legal_basis.p1: We process your data based on (LGPD art. 7 and art. 11): (a) contract performance, to deliver the Service you contracted; (b) consent, for sensitive health data, marketing, and non-essential cookies; (c) legitimate interest, for security, fraud prevention, and Service improvement; (d) legal obligation, for tax retention and authority requests.
legal_basis.p2: You can withdraw consent at any time (Profile → Privacy), which may limit features that depend on the data.

purposes.title: 4. Why we process your data
purposes.p1: (a) Create and manage your account; (b) generate adaptive workouts and personalized AI programs; (c) read lab reports via OCR and organize results; (d) deliver weekly performance reviews; (e) process payments; (f) send transactional service notices; (g) prevent fraud and abuse; (h) comply with legal obligations.

sharing.title: 5. With whom we share
sharing.p1: Operators processing data on our behalf: OpenAI (program generation, lab reading), Anthropic (weekly reviews), Google (AI program composition), Stripe (payments), hosting provider [Coolify/AWS/etc.], transactional email service [Resend/SendGrid], Apple (HealthKit) and Google (Calendar) — only when you enable these integrations.
sharing.p2: We do not sell your personal data. We do not share health data for advertising. AI calls use anonymous descriptions (e.g. "intermediate athlete, HRV 52ms") and do not include your name, email, or identifiers.
sharing.p3: We may disclose data to authorities when legally required, while challenging abusive requests.

international.title: 6. International transfers
international.p1: Some operators (especially AI providers and infrastructure) process data in the United States and other countries. We use appropriate contractual and technical measures (encryption in transit and at rest, per-user segregation) to ensure protection consistent with the LGPD.

retention.title: 7. Retention
retention.p1: We keep your data while your account is active. After cancellation, we keep it for 30 days to allow recovery or export, then erase or anonymize production records.
retention.p2: Financial data (invoices, payment records) may be retained up to 5 years to meet tax and accounting obligations. Security logs are kept for up to 6 months.

your_rights.title: 8. Your rights (LGPD art. 18)
your_rights.p1: You may, free of charge, at any time: (a) confirm processing exists; (b) access your data; (c) correct incomplete or outdated data; (d) request anonymization, blocking, or deletion of unnecessary data; (e) request portability; (f) request deletion of consent-based data; (g) be informed of operators with whom we share; (h) withdraw consent; (i) object to legitimate-interest processing.
your_rights.p2: To exercise any right, contact {dpo_email}. We respond within 15 days. If unsatisfied, you may complain to the Brazilian Data Protection Authority (ANPD) at gov.br/anpd.

security.title: 9. Security
security.p1: We adopt reasonable measures: passwords stored as bcrypt hashes, signed JWT, HTTPS transport, per-user database isolation, least-privilege for AI integrations, access monitoring, and regular backups.
security.p2: In the event of a security incident that may pose risk or relevant harm to data subjects, we will notify the ANPD and affected users within a reasonable timeframe, per LGPD art. 48.

cookies.title: 10. Cookies and local storage
cookies.p1: We use essential cookies and localStorage for authentication (JWT token), language preference, and theme. We do not use behavioral advertising cookies or third-party trackers.

children.title: 11. Minors
children.p1: The Service is intended for adults aged 18+. We do not knowingly collect data from minors. If we identify an account belonging to a minor without legal-guardian consent, it will be closed and the data deleted.

changes.title: 12. Changes to this Policy
changes.p1: We may update this Policy. Material changes will be communicated at least 15 days in advance by email and/or in-app notice. The version and date appear at the top of this document.
